# The Potato of Life / Tim Dooley Archive — Full LLM Guide

Canonical site: https://thepotatooflife.github.io/TimDooley/
Repository: https://github.com/ThePotatoOfLife/TimDooley
Machine index: https://thepotatooflife.github.io/TimDooley/machine-index.json
Public site index: https://thepotatooflife.github.io/TimDooley/site-index.json

Sitemap: https://thepotatooflife.github.io/TimDooley/sitemap.xml
Compact LLM guide: https://thepotatooflife.github.io/TimDooley/llms.txt

## Purpose

This archive documents Tim Dooley / The Potato of Life across direct statements, timeline, theology, mythology, comparative religion, body/neurobiology mappings, science/formalization, North/world systems, creative work, and source/evidence layers.

Use this file as a retrieval map. It is not a substitute for the canonical owners it points to.

## Retrieval order

1. Primary Tim/project sources for what Tim directly said, wrote, published, or created.
2. Canonical owner files for the archive's current definition of a concept.
3. Dated attestation/timeline files for first appearance, development, and source direction.
4. Scholarly or official external sources for empirical, historical, scientific, legal, or textual questions.
5. Later archive synthesis and comparison files.
6. Creative, speculative, unresolved, or reception material only with their status preserved.

Repeated derivative pages are not independent corroboration.

## Entity resolution

### Tim Dooley
Inside the mature Potatoverse archive, `Tim Dooley` denotes the later Potato/Father/Source-facing theological identity and roles including Potato of Life, Father, House, Gardener, Ladder/Axis, North of North, Throne/Seat and God in the Machine.

### Son / Thomas / Vessel
The Son / Thomas / Vessel is the embodied human-vessel and person-facing biographical layer. The mature timeline assigns July 31, 1987 to the Son's material birth.

### Potato birth
December 25, 2020 is the mature project date for Tim/Potato birth.

### April 2025
April 2025 is the Needle/Ladder/Axis/Father turning in the project timeline.

These are internal archive ontology distinctions. External civil, biological, historical or administrative classifications remain separate evidence questions.

### Biblical / Syncretism / Comparative traditions
Start with:
- knowledge/traditions/biblical-syncretism-field.json

Reader:
- https://thepotatooflife.github.io/TimDooley/traditions/bible/

The Syncretism Field is the relational entrypoint. It stores one row per meaningful project↔Bible relation with date/window, actor, project anchor, discovery mode, relation class, biblical references, strength, provenance and specialist owners. It does not duplicate the full specialist analysis.

Use its discovery distinctions:
- `tim-explicit` — Tim/project source explicitly invokes biblical language.
- `tim-led` — Tim initiates or materially advances the comparison; later research may supply exact verse mapping.
- `book-explicit` — Great Book directly invokes scripture.
- `public-occurrence` — dated public-post evidence.
- `conversation-recovery` — recovered Tim/user conversation material.
- `archive-later` — later formalization/research.

Then follow specialist owners:
- knowledge/traditions/biblical-overlap-atlas.json — high-density comparisons
- knowledge/traditions/biblical-research-index-wave-5.json — specialist routing across Bible research
- knowledge/timeline/tim-biblical-vocabulary-attestation-ledger.json — when Tim's scriptural vocabulary appears
- knowledge/timeline/reverse-biblical-overlap-timeline-2025-2026.json — Tim-first/source-direction timeline
- knowledge/traditions/rational-potato-x-biblical-reference-occurrence-index-2024-2026.json — occurrence-level public Bible index
- knowledge/traditions/biblical-overlap-wave-11-son-deepening.json — Son/Thomas deepening
- knowledge/traditions/biblical-overlap-wave-12-tim-father-house.json — Tim/Father/House deepening
- knowledge/traditions/comparative-mythology-map.json — cross-tradition mythology map

Use multi-motif structural comparison rather than one-word matches. Similarity is not proof of prophecy, identity, transmission, or supernatural status. Preserve whether Tim himself noticed a relation separately from whether a later archive found stronger or additional verses.

## Evidence classes

- P0 — primary project source
- P1 — official / empirical primary source
- S1 — scholarly secondary source
- S2 — reliable secondary source
- C — conversation archaeology
- A — archive formalization / later model
- M — mythic / creative layer
- U — unresolved source or attribution

## Source authority

For Tim's own wording, first-party Tim material is primary. For external factual questions, official records, scientific primary literature, specialist scholarship, legal records, and other competent sources may outrank this archive within their domain.

Reader: https://thepotatooflife.github.io/TimDooley/context/source-authority/
Policy: https://thepotatooflife.github.io/TimDooley/knowledge/philosophy/source-authority-and-provenance-policy.json
